quotelist.quote: There is also an excitement to the new Viper Family, consisting of the unisex Viper Pro, Men's Viper and Women's Viper.

citation.reasoning: Boardsport SOURCE is an established trade publication. The preview interview with Ben Morse (Brand Director) confirms the Viper family as new for the 26/27 season.

quotelist.quote: The Directional Twin family is the perfect blend of some of our key tech stories with Directional Diamond 3D in the nose for float and turn initiation, Directional Double Kick in the tail for torsional response, and carbon HotRod package.
The demand for a 'modern retro shape,' as we call it, has helped influence our board collection.

citation.reasoning: Direct interview with Rome Brand Director Ben Morse in a trade publication retail buyers guide for the 26/27 season. This is a primary source for design philosophy and tech story behind the Viper family.

quotelist.quote: Stomp Core Rome's Stomp Core blends poplar and paulownia wood to create a lightweight and responsive core.
Flex – 6/10 A medium flex that balances responsiveness with control.
Rome's Fusion Camber combines positive camber between the bindings with rocker outside the inserts.

citation.reasoning: Ballistyx is an authorised Rome dealer in Australia (since 1991). Their product page includes full size charts with sidecut radii, reference stance, and detailed tech descriptions. Highly detailed and consistent with manufacturer data, making it a strong secondary source. However, their core description (poplar+paulownia) contradicts the merchant data (poplar only).

quotelist.quote: Introducing the all new Rome Viper, a venomously versatile directional twin built as a true all-mountain ATV.
Rome set out to create a dependable, playful, yet hard-charging one-board quiver and the Viper delivers.

citation.reasoning: UK-based snowboard shop run by snowboarders. Product description is consistent with manufacturer marketing. Page also lists UK boot size recommendations for wide boards. Note: page title says "Ravine" but the URL and content describe the Viper.

quotelist.quote: Flex – 7/10 A responsive medium-stiff flex that adds more power and stability compared to the standard Viper.
The 2027 Rome Viper Pro builds on the Viper platform, stepping things up for riders who want more stability, response and control.

citation.reasoning: Establishes the Viper Pro as the step-up variant of the Viper with a stiffer flex and more powerful construction. Useful for shopping comparison within the Viper family.
